notes: CatWars is the on-chain 1v1 cat-fight betting game in native ETH (src/CatWars.sol). Its constructor takes (address vrfWrapper, address owner_): the first argument is the requester-specified Chainlink VRF v2.5 direct-funding wrapper on Sepolia, 0x195f15F2d49d693cE265b4fB0fdDbE15b1850Cc1, and the second is $owner, the launch owner, who also becomes the initial treasury and keeper. The constructor makes no external calls and needs no post-deploy setup. CatWarsEngine (src/CatWarsEngine.sol) is an internal library compiled into CatWars and is not deployed or linked separately. The launch token LaunchToken (CAT WARS, MEOW) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 independent of the game; the game holds no launch tokens and bets are placed in ETH only.
